verdict.justification: Both deliverables accurately implement the Excel formulas for Price Mismatch and Case Pack errors (properly handling floating-point precision with ROUND), create grouped outline summary tables with PO-level drill-down, and arrive at the exact same error counts and dollar variances. Deliverable B wins because its analysis is more observant, actionable, and free of meta-commentary. Specifically, Deliverable B spots a critical customer pattern—that "Granite Small Co. accounts for 5 of the 10 Case Pack errors, although it has only 8 of the 41 lines"—and includes a complete reference table of all 10 Case Pack error lines in the Word memo so Order Management can act immediately. Deliverable B also orders its Excel summary table by Total Errors descending (starting with SKU-0107) and includes helpful context columns like UOM and Case Pack via INDEX/MATCH. Finally, Deliverable A includes an odd meta-artifact in its memo referring to its execution environment ("No operative-record registry or other operations records were in the workspace folder") and miscounts the multi-line PO/SKU pairs as three instead of four (missing PO1010/SKU-0118).

decisive_issues.issue: Includes meta-commentary referencing the AI workspace environment in the client-facing Word document.
